'''2018 Online Championship Series''' was the Players Committee online championship series on GEMP. [[Justin Desai]] is the published winner. Constructed pair lists for the playoffs were not posted on the later wrap pages.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/major-event-winners/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' 2018
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Desai]]
